teachers.label: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Hurmuz al-Aʿraj
teachers.translation: Nāfiʿ read under seventy of the Tābiʿūn, among them Abū Jaʿfar and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Hurmuz al-Aʿraj.

teachers.label: Abū Jaʿfar
teachers.translation: Nāfiʿ read under seventy of the Tābiʿūn, among them Abū Jaʿfar.

teachers.label: Muḥammad b. Muslim b. Shihāb al-Zuhrī
teachers.translation: Nāfiʿ read under seventy of the Tābiʿūn, among them Abū Jaʿfar, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Hurmuz al-Aʿraj, Muslim b. Jundab, and Muḥammad b. Muslim b. Shihāb al-Zuhrī.

teachers.label: Muslim b. Jundab
teachers.translation: Nāfiʿ read under seventy of the Tābiʿūn, among them Abū Jaʿfar, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Hurmuz al-Aʿraj, and Muslim b. Jundab.

teachers.label: Ṣāliḥ b. Khawwāt
teachers.translation: Nāfiʿ read under seventy of the Tābiʿūn, among them Abū Jaʿfar, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Hurmuz al-Aʿraj, Muslim b. Jundab, Muḥammad b. Muslim b. Shihāb al-Zuhrī, and Ṣāliḥ b. Khawwāt.

teachers.label: Shayba b. Niṣāḥ
teachers.translation: Nāfiʿ read under seventy of the Tābiʿūn, among them Abū Jaʿfar, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Hurmuz al-Aʿraj, Muslim b. Jundab, Muḥammad b. Muslim b. Shihāb al-Zuhrī, Ṣāliḥ b. Khawwāt, and Shayba b. Niṣāḥ.

teachers.label: Yazīd b. Rūmān
teachers.translation: Nāfiʿ read under seventy of the Tābiʿūn, among them Abū Jaʿfar, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Hurmuz al-Aʿraj, Muslim b. Jundab, Muḥammad b. Muslim b. Shihāb al-Zuhrī, Ṣāliḥ b. Khawwāt, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, and Yazīd b. Rūmān.
teachers.note: *minhum* ("among them") marks each name as one of the seventy and not as an exhaustive list.

students.label: Ibn Jammāz
students.translation: […] Ibn Jammāz) shortly after the year one hundred and seventy. He was an eminent Qurʾān teacher, precise and noble, and sought out for the reading of Abū Jaʿfar and Nāfiʿ; he transmitted the reading by full recitation (*ʿarḍan*) from the two of them.
students.note: the excerpt begins mid-sentence, with a closing parenthesis after the name, so the verb governing "shortly after the year 170" lies outside the supplied text. The pronoun in *ʿanhumā* is dual and covers both Abū Jaʿfar and Nāfiʿ.

students.label: Isḥāq al-Musayyabī
students.translation: […] Isḥāq al-Musayyabī, the companion (*ṣāḥib*) of Nāfiʿ.
students.note: the book calls him the "companion" of Nāfiʿ and does not use the verb "read" here.

students.label: Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar
students.translation: Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar read under Shayba b. Niṣāḥ and Nāfiʿ.
students.note: the index says the chain is referred back to an earlier entry (*wa-taqaddama sanaduhumā*). That phrase is not in the Arabic supplied here.

students.label: Qālūn
students.translation: Qālūn and Warsh read under the imam of Medina and its Qurʾān teacher Abū Ruwaym (and it is said Abū l-Ḥasan), Nāfiʿ b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Nuʿaym al-Laythī, their client (*mawlāhum*), the Medinan.

students.label: Warsh
students.translation: Qālūn and Warsh read under the imam of Medina and its Qurʾān teacher Abū Ruwaym (and it is said Abū l-Ḥasan), Nāfiʿ b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Nuʿaym al-Laythī, their client (*mawlāhum*), the Medinan.
students.note: *wa-yuqālu* ("and it is said") qualifies only the choice between the kunyas Abū Ruwaym and Abū l-Ḥasan. The statement that both men read under Nāfiʿ is not hedged.

teachers.label: ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Sāʾib al-Makhzūmī
teachers.translation: Ibn Kathīr read under Abū l-Sāʾib ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Sāʾib b. Abī l-Sāʾib al-Makhzūmī.

teachers.label: Dirbās, mawlā of Ibn ʿAbbās
teachers.translation: Ibn Kathīr read under Abū l-Sāʾib ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Sāʾib b. Abī l-Sāʾib al-Makhzūmī, under Abū l-Ḥajjāj Mujāhid b. Jabr al-Makkī, and under Dirbās, the client (*mawlā*) of Ibn ʿAbbās.

teachers.label: Mujāhid b. Jabr
teachers.translation: Ibn Kathīr read under Abū l-Sāʾib ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Sāʾib b. Abī l-Sāʾib al-Makhzūmī and under Abū l-Ḥajjāj Mujāhid b. Jabr al-Makkī.

students.label: Abū ʿAmr
students.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, and ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr.
students.note: the book names ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr here without further description, and it says that Mujāhid's isnād was given in the reading of Ibn Kathīr. The index identifies him with the reader Ibn Kathīr on that basis.

students.label: Ismāʿīl b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Qusṭantīn (al-Qisṭ)
students.translation: Al-Qisṭ also read, together with Maʿrūf and Shibl, under the shaykh of Mecca and its imam in recitation, Abū Maʿbad ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr b. ʿAmr b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Zādhān b. Fayrūzān b. Hurmuz al-Dārī al-Makkī.
students.note: the word *aydan* ("also") indicates that al-Qisṭ read under Ibn Kathīr in addition to his reading under Maʿrūf and Shibl. The same sentence serves the next two entries.

students.label: Maʿrūf b. Mushkān
students.translation: Al-Qisṭ also read, together with Maʿrūf and Shibl, under the shaykh of Mecca and its imam in recitation, Abū Maʿbad ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr b. ʿAmr b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Zādhān b. Fayrūzān b. Hurmuz al-Dārī al-Makkī.

students.label: Shibl b. ʿAbbād
students.translation: Al-Qisṭ also read, together with Maʿrūf and Shibl, under the shaykh of Mecca and its imam in recitation, Abū Maʿbad ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr b. ʿAmr b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Zādhān b. Fayrūzān b. Hurmuz al-Dārī al-Makkī.

teachers.label: ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Isḥāq al-Ḥaḍramī
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, Mujāhid b. Jabr, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, Abū l-ʿĀliya Rufayʿ b. Mihrān al-Riyāḥī, Ḥumayd b. Qays al-Aʿraj al-Makkī, and ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Isḥāq al-Ḥaḍramī.

teachers.label: Abū l-ʿĀliya Rufayʿ b. Mihrān al-Riyāḥī
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, Mujāhid b. Jabr, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, and Abū l-ʿĀliya Rufayʿ b. Mihrān al-Riyāḥī.

teachers.label: Abū Jaʿfar
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ.
teachers.note: this teacher's own isnād is given in another reader's entry and is not repeated here.

teachers.label: al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, Mujāhid b. Jabr, and al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī.

teachers.label: ʿĀṣim
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, Mujāhid b. Jabr, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, Abū l-ʿĀliya Rufayʿ b. Mihrān al-Riyāḥī, Ḥumayd b. Qays al-Aʿraj al-Makkī, ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Isḥāq al-Ḥaḍramī, ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ, ʿIkrima b. Khālid, ʿIkrima the client of Ibn ʿAbbās, Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Muḥayṣin, and ʿĀṣim b. Abī l-Najūd.
teachers.note: this teacher's own isnād is given in another reader's entry and is not repeated here.

teachers.label: ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, Mujāhid b. Jabr, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, Abū l-ʿĀliya Rufayʿ b. Mihrān al-Riyāḥī, Ḥumayd b. Qays al-Aʿraj al-Makkī, ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Isḥāq al-Ḥaḍramī, and ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ.

teachers.label: Ḥumayd b. Qays al-Aʿraj al-Makkī
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, Mujāhid b. Jabr, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, Abū l-ʿĀliya Rufayʿ b. Mihrān al-Riyāḥī, and Ḥumayd b. Qays al-Aʿraj al-Makkī.

teachers.label: Ibn Kathīr
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, and ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr.
teachers.note: the book names ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr here without further description and says that Mujāhid's isnād was given in the reading of Ibn Kathīr. The index identifies him with the reader Ibn Kathīr on that basis.

teachers.label: Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Muḥayṣin
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, Mujāhid b. Jabr, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, Abū l-ʿĀliya Rufayʿ b. Mihrān al-Riyāḥī, Ḥumayd b. Qays al-Aʿraj al-Makkī, ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Isḥāq al-Ḥaḍramī, ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ, ʿIkrima b. Khālid, ʿIkrima the client of Ibn ʿAbbās, and Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Muḥayṣin.

teachers.label: ʿIkrima b. Khālid
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, Mujāhid b. Jabr, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, Abū l-ʿĀliya Rufayʿ b. Mihrān al-Riyāḥī, Ḥumayd b. Qays al-Aʿraj al-Makkī, ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Isḥāq al-Ḥaḍramī, ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ, and ʿIkrima b. Khālid.

teachers.label: ʿIkrima, mawlā of Ibn ʿAbbās
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, Mujāhid b. Jabr, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, Abū l-ʿĀliya Rufayʿ b. Mihrān al-Riyāḥī, Ḥumayd b. Qays al-Aʿraj al-Makkī, ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Isḥāq al-Ḥaḍramī, ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ, ʿIkrima b. Khālid, and ʿIkrima the client of Ibn ʿAbbās.

teachers.label: Mujāhid b. Jabr
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, and Mujāhid b. Jabr.

teachers.label: Naṣr b. ʿĀṣim
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, Mujāhid b. Jabr, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, Abū l-ʿĀliya Rufayʿ b. Mihrān al-Riyāḥī, Ḥumayd b. Qays al-Aʿraj al-Makkī, ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Isḥāq al-Ḥaḍramī, ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ, ʿIkrima b. Khālid, ʿIkrima the client of Ibn ʿAbbās, Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Muḥayṣin, ʿĀṣim b. Abī l-Najūd, and Naṣr b. ʿĀṣim.

teachers.label: Shayba b. Niṣāḥ
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, and Shayba b. Niṣāḥ.
teachers.note: this teacher's own isnād is given in another reader's entry and is not repeated here.

teachers.label: Yaḥyā b. Yaʿmur
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, Mujāhid b. Jabr, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, Abū l-ʿĀliya Rufayʿ b. Mihrān al-Riyāḥī, Ḥumayd b. Qays al-Aʿraj al-Makkī, ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Isḥāq al-Ḥaḍramī, ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ, ʿIkrima b. Khālid, ʿIkrima the client of Ibn ʿAbbās, Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Muḥayṣin, ʿĀṣim b. Abī l-Najūd, Naṣr b. ʿĀṣim, and Yaḥyā b. Yaʿmur.

teachers.label: Yazīd b. Rūmān
teachers.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ and Yazīd b. Rūmān.
teachers.note: this teacher's own isnād is given in another reader's entry and is not repeated here.

students.label: al-Yazīdī (Yaḥyā b. al-Mubārak)
students.translation: Al-Yazīdī read under the imam of Basra and its Qurʾān teacher, Abū ʿAmr Zayyān b. al-ʿAlāʾ b. ʿAmmār al-ʿUryān b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ḥuṣayn b. al-Ḥārith al-Māzinī al-Baṣrī.

students.label: Hārūn b. Mūsā al-ʿAtakī al-Aʿwar
students.translation: Hārūn read under ʿĀṣim al-Jaḥdarī and Abū ʿAmr, by the chain of the two.
students.note: the book refers the chain back (*bi-sanadihimā*). The pronoun is dual and covers both ʿĀṣim al-Jaḥdarī and Abū ʿAmr.

students.label: Sallām b. Sulaymān al-Ṭawīl
students.translation: Sallām read under ʿĀṣim al-Kūfī and under Abū ʿAmr.
students.note: the supplied Arabic is the opening clause only. The index says the chain is referred back to an earlier entry (*wa-taqaddama sanaduhumā*, "and their chain has preceded") and that the sentence crosses the page break.

students.label: Yaʿqūb
students.translation: Yaʿqūb read under Abū l-Mundhir Sallām b. Sulaymān al-Muzanī, their client (*mawlāhum*), al-Ṭawīl; under Shihāb b. Sharīfa; under Abū Yaḥyā Mahdī b. Maymūn al-Miʿwalī; and under Abū l-Ashhab Jaʿfar b. Ḥayyān al-ʿUṭāridī. And it is said that he read under Abū ʿAmr himself.
students.note: the book reports the last link only as a saying (*wa-qīla: innahu qaraʾa ʿalā Abī ʿAmrin nafsihi*), and the pronoun refers to Yaʿqūb.

teachers.label: Abū l-Dardāʾ ʿUwaymir b. Zayd
teachers.translation: Ibn ʿĀmir read under Abū Hāshim al-Mughīra b. Abī Shihāb ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAmr b. al-Mughīra al-Makhzūmī, without disagreement among the verifiers (*muḥaqqiqūn*), and under Abū l-Dardāʾ ʿUwaymir b. Zayd b. Qays, according to what the *ḥāfiẓ* Abū ʿAmr al-Dānī stated definitively, and it is sound with us from him.
teachers.note: the book presents the link to Abū l-Dardāʾ as a claim that al-Dānī asserted (*fīmā qaṭaʿa bihi*) and as sound in the author's judgment (*wa-ṣaḥḥa ʿindanā ʿanhu*). The link to al-Mughīra, by contrast, carries the statement that the verifiers do not disagree about it.

teachers.label: al-Mughīra b. Abī Shihāb al-Makhzūmī
teachers.translation: Ibn ʿĀmir read under Abū Hāshim al-Mughīra b. Abī Shihāb ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAmr b. al-Mughīra al-Makhzūmī, without disagreement among the verifiers.

students.label: Yaḥyā b. al-Ḥārith al-Dhimārī
students.translation: Al-Dhimārī read under the imam of the people of Syria, Abū ʿImrān ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿĀmir b. Yazīd b. Tamīm b. Rabīʿa al-Yaḥṣubī.

teachers.label: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Sulamī
teachers.translation: ʿĀṣim read under Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥabīb b. Rabīʿa al-Sulamī, the blind.

teachers.label: Abū ʿAmr Saʿd b. Ilyās al-Shaybānī
teachers.translation: ʿĀṣim read under Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥabīb b. Rabīʿa al-Sulamī, the blind, under Abū Maryam Zirr b. Ḥubaysh b. Ḥubāsha al-Asadī, and under Abū ʿAmr Saʿd b. Ilyās al-Shaybānī.

teachers.label: Zirr b. Ḥubaysh
teachers.translation: ʿĀṣim read under Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥabīb b. Rabīʿa al-Sulamī, the blind, and under Abū Maryam Zirr b. Ḥubaysh b. Ḥubāsha al-Asadī.

students.label: Abān al-ʿAṭṭār
students.translation: Abū Bakr, al-Mufaḍḍal, and Abān read under ʿĀṣim.

students.label: Abū ʿAmr
students.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ, Yazīd b. Rūmān, Shayba b. Niṣāḥ, ʿAbd Allāh b. Kathīr, Mujāhid b. Jabr, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, Abū l-ʿĀliya Rufayʿ b. Mihrān al-Riyāḥī, Ḥumayd b. Qays al-Aʿraj al-Makkī, ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Isḥāq al-Ḥaḍramī, ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ, ʿIkrima b. Khālid, ʿIkrima the client of Ibn ʿAbbās, Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Muḥayṣin, and ʿĀṣim b. Abī l-Najūd.
students.note: this teacher's own isnād appears in another reader's entry and is not repeated here.

students.label: al-Mufaḍḍal al-Ḍabbī
students.translation: Abū Bakr, al-Mufaḍḍal, and Abān read under ʿĀṣim.

students.label: Ḥafṣ
students.translation: Ḥafṣ and Abū Bakr read under the imam of Kufa and its reader, Abū Bakr ʿĀṣim b. Abī l-Najūd.

students.label: ʿĪsā b. ʿUmar al-Hamdhānī
students.translation: ʿĪsā b. ʿUmar read under ʿĀṣim.
students.note: the index says that the chains are referred back to earlier entries (*wa-taqaddama sanaduhum*). That phrase does not appear in the Arabic supplied, so it is not translated.

students.label: Sallām b. Sulaymān al-Ṭawīl
students.translation: Sallām read under ʿĀṣim al-Kūfī and under Abū ʿAmr.
students.note: the supplied Arabic is the opening clause only. The index says the chain is referred back (*wa-taqaddama sanaduhumā*, "and their chain has preceded") and that the sentence crosses the page break.

students.label: Shuʿba
students.translation: Ḥafṣ and Abū Bakr read under the imam of Kufa and its reader, Abū Bakr ʿĀṣim b. Abī l-Najūd.
students.note: the book names the transmitter only by his kunya, Abū Bakr. The index identifies him as Shuʿba (Abū Bakr b. ʿAyyāsh) from the context, since ʿĀṣim's transmitters are being listed. The teacher, ʿĀṣim, bears the same kunya in this sentence.

teachers.label: ʿAmr b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Sabīʿī (Abū Isḥāq)
teachers.translation: Ḥamza also read under Abū Ḥamza Ḥumrān b. Aʿyan and under Abū Isḥāq ʿAmr b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Sabīʿī.

teachers.label: Ḥumrān b. Aʿyan
teachers.translation: Ḥamza also read under Abū Ḥamza Ḥumrān b. Aʿyan.

teachers.label: Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā
teachers.translation: Ḥamza also read under Abū Ḥamza Ḥumrān b. Aʿyan, under Abū Isḥāq ʿAmr b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Sabīʿī, and under Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā.

teachers.label: Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq
teachers.translation: Ḥamza also read under Abū Ḥamza Ḥumrān b. Aʿyan, under Abū Isḥāq ʿAmr b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Sabīʿī, under Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā, under Abū Muḥammad Ṭalḥa b. Muṣarrif al-Yāmī, and under Abū ʿAbd Allāh Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq b. Muḥammad al-Bāqir b. Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn ʿAlī b. al-Ḥusayn b. ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib al-Hāshimī.

teachers.label: Sulaymān b. Mihrān al-Aʿmash
teachers.translation: Ḥamza read under Abū Muḥammad Sulaymān b. Mihrān al-Aʿmash by full recitation (*ʿarḍan*), and it is said: only the *ḥurūf*.
teachers.note: the book hedges this link. It gives reading by full recitation (*ʿarḍan*) and then reports, with *wa-qīla* ("and it is said"), the alternative that the relationship covered only the *ḥurūf*, the individual variant readings.

teachers.label: Ṭalḥa b. Muṣarrif al-Yāmī
teachers.translation: Ḥamza also read under Abū Ḥamza Ḥumrān b. Aʿyan, under Abū Isḥāq ʿAmr b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Sabīʿī, under Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā, and under Abū Muḥammad Ṭalḥa b. Muṣarrif al-Yāmī.

students.label: al-Kisāʾī
students.translation: Al-Kisāʾī read under Ḥamza, and his reliance was upon him.
students.note: the index says the chain is referred back to an earlier entry (*wa-taqaddama sanaduhu*). That phrase is not in the Arabic supplied here.

students.label: Salīm b. ʿĪsā al-Ḥanafī
students.translation: Sulaym read under the imam of Kufa, Abū ʿImāra Ḥamza b. Ḥabīb b. ʿImāra b. Ismāʿīl al-Kūfī al-Zayyāt.

teachers.label: Ḥamza
teachers.translation: Al-Kisāʾī read under Ḥamza, and his reliance was upon him.
teachers.note: the index says his chain is referred back to an earlier entry (*wa-taqaddama sanaduhu*), which the supplied Arabic does not contain.

teachers.label: ʿĪsā b. ʿUmar al-Hamdhānī
teachers.translation: Al-Kisāʾī read under Ḥamza, and his reliance was upon him; his chain has preceded. He also read under Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā; his chain has preceded. He also read under ʿĪsā b. ʿUmar al-Hamdhānī.

teachers.label: Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar
teachers.translation: Al-Kisāʾī read under Ḥamza, and his reliance was upon him; his chain has preceded. He also read under Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā; his chain has preceded. He also read under ʿĪsā b. ʿUmar al-Hamdhānī. He also transmitted the *ḥurūf* from Abū Bakr b. ʿAyyāsh and from Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar.
teachers.note: the verb here is *rawā* ("transmitted") with the object *al-ḥurūf*, not *qaraʾa ʿalā*, so the book does not say that al-Kisāʾī read under Ismāʿīl.

teachers.label: Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā
teachers.translation: Al-Kisāʾī read under Ḥamza, and his reliance was upon him; his chain has preceded. He also read under Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā.
teachers.note: the index says the chain is referred back to an earlier entry; the Arabic supplied contains the phrase *wa-taqaddama sanaduhu* after the Ḥamza clause.

teachers.label: Shuʿba
teachers.translation: Al-Kisāʾī read under Ḥamza, and his reliance was upon him; his chain has preceded. He also read under Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā; his chain has preceded. He also read under ʿĪsā b. ʿUmar al-Hamdhānī. He also transmitted the *ḥurūf* from Abū Bakr b. ʿAyyāsh.
teachers.note: as in the preceding entry, the verb is *rawā* with *al-ḥurūf*, so this is a transmission of variant readings and not a reading under him.

teachers.label: Zāʾida b. Qudāma
teachers.translation: Al-Kisāʾī read under Ḥamza, and his reliance was upon him; his chain has preceded. He also read under Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā; his chain has preceded. He also read under ʿĪsā b. ʿUmar al-Hamdhānī. He also transmitted the *ḥurūf* from Abū Bakr b. ʿAyyāsh, from Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar, and from Zāʾida b. Qudāma.
teachers.note: here too the verb is *rawā* with *al-ḥurūf*.

students.label: Abū l-Ḥārith
students.translation: Abū l-Ḥārith and al-Dūrī read under Abū l-Ḥasan ʿAlī b. Ḥamza b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Bahman b. Fayrūz al-Kisāʾī al-Kūfī.

students.label: al-Dūrī
students.translation: Abū l-Ḥārith and al-Dūrī read under Abū l-Ḥasan ʿAlī b. Ḥamza b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Bahman b. Fayrūz al-Kisāʾī al-Kūfī.
students.note: the book uses the same nisba, al-Dūrī, for the transmitter of Abū ʿAmr in the preceding sentence, and the index records this al-Dūrī as al-Kisāʾī's transmitter.

students.label: Khalaf al-ʿĀshir
students.translation: Khalaf read under Sulaym, the companion of Ḥamza, as has preceded; under Yaʿqūb b. Khalīfa al-Aʿshā, the companion of Abū Bakr; and under Abū Zayd Saʿīd b. Aws al-Anṣārī, the companion of al-Mufaḍḍal al-Ḍabbī and Abān al-ʿAṭṭār. Abū Bakr, al-Mufaḍḍal, and Abān read under ʿĀṣim, and the chain of ʿĀṣim has preceded. He also transmitted the *ḥurūf* from Isḥāq al-Musayyabī, the companion of Nāfiʿ, and from Yaḥyā b. Ādam, from Abū Bakr as well, and from al-Kisāʾī.
students.note: the verb governing al-Kisāʾī is *rawā al-ḥurūf* ("transmitted the *ḥurūf*"). The index adds that the book says he did not read under al-Kisāʾī by full recitation (*wa-lam yaqraʾ ʿalayhi ʿarḍan*), a phrase that lies outside the Arabic supplied.

teachers.label: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbbās
teachers.translation: Abū Jaʿfar read under his master (*mawlā*), ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAyyāsh b. Abī Rabīʿa al-Makhzūmī, and under the learned scholar, the ocean (*al-ḥabr al-baḥr*), ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbbās.

teachers.label: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAyyāsh b. Abī Rabīʿa
teachers.translation: Abū Jaʿfar read under his master (*mawlā*), ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAyyāsh b. Abī Rabīʿa.

teachers.label: Abū Hurayra
teachers.translation: Abū Jaʿfar read under his master (*mawlā*), ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAyyāsh b. Abī Rabīʿa al-Makhzūmī, under the learned scholar, the ocean, ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbbās al-Hāshimī, and under Abū Hurayra.

teachers.label: Zayd b. Thābit
teachers.translation: And it is said that Abū Jaʿfar read under Zayd himself, and that is possible.
teachers.note: the book hedges this with both *wa-qīla* ("and it is said") and *wa-dhālika muḥtamal* ("and that is possible"), which presents it as a possibility and not as part of the main chain.

students.label: Abū ʿAmr
students.translation: Abū ʿAmr read under Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ.
students.note: this teacher's own isnād is given in another reader's entry and is not repeated here.

students.label: Ibn Jammāz
students.translation: Ibn Jammāz and Ibn Wardān read under the imam of the reading of Medina, Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ al-Makhzūmī al-Madanī.

students.label: Ibn Wardān
students.translation: Ibn Jammāz and Ibn Wardān read under the imam of the reading of Medina, Abū Jaʿfar Yazīd b. al-Qaʿqāʿ al-Makhzūmī al-Madanī.

students.label: Nāfiʿ
students.translation: Nāfiʿ read under seventy of the Tābiʿūn, among them Abū Jaʿfar.
students.note: *minhum* ("among them") marks Abū Jaʿfar as one of the seventy.

teachers.label: Abū l-Ashhab Jaʿfar b. Ḥayyān al-ʿUṭāridī
teachers.translation: Yaʿqūb read under Abū l-Mundhir Sallām b. Sulaymān al-Muzanī, their client (*mawlāhum*), al-Ṭawīl; under Shihāb b. Sharīfa; under Abū Yaḥyā Mahdī b. Maymūn al-Miʿwalī; and under Abū l-Ashhab Jaʿfar b. Ḥayyān al-ʿUṭāridī.

teachers.label: Abū ʿAmr
teachers.translation: Yaʿqūb read under Abū l-Mundhir Sallām b. Sulaymān al-Muzanī, their client, al-Ṭawīl; under Shihāb b. Sharīfa; under Abū Yaḥyā Mahdī b. Maymūn al-Miʿwalī; and under Abū l-Ashhab Jaʿfar b. Ḥayyān al-ʿUṭāridī. And it is said that he read under Abū ʿAmr himself.
teachers.note: the book reports this link only as a saying (*wa-qīla: innahu qaraʾa ʿalā Abī ʿAmrin nafsihi*), and the pronoun in *innahu* refers to Yaʿqūb.

teachers.label: Mahdī b. Maymūn al-Miʿwalī
teachers.translation: Yaʿqūb read under Abū l-Mundhir Sallām b. Sulaymān al-Muzanī, their client, al-Ṭawīl; under Shihāb b. Sharīfa; and under Abū Yaḥyā Mahdī b. Maymūn al-Miʿwalī.

teachers.label: Sallām b. Sulaymān al-Ṭawīl
teachers.translation: Yaʿqūb read under Abū l-Mundhir Sallām b. Sulaymān al-Muzanī, their client, al-Ṭawīl.

teachers.label: Shihāb b. Sharīfa
teachers.translation: Yaʿqūb read under Abū l-Mundhir Sallām b. Sulaymān al-Muzanī, their client, al-Ṭawīl, and under Shihāb b. Sharīfa.

students.label: Rawḥ
students.translation: Rawḥ and Ruways read under the imam of Basra, Abū Muḥammad Yaʿqūb b. Isḥāq b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Isḥāq al-Ḥaḍramī, their client, the Basran.

students.label: Ruways
students.translation: Rawḥ and Ruways read under the imam of Basra, Abū Muḥammad Yaʿqūb b. Isḥāq b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Isḥāq al-Ḥaḍramī, their client, the Basran.

teachers.label: Abū Zayd Saʿīd b. Aws al-Anṣārī
teachers.translation: Khalaf read under Sulaym, the companion of Ḥamza, as has preceded; under Yaʿqūb b. Khalīfa al-Aʿshā, the companion of Abū Bakr; and under Abū Zayd Saʿīd b. Aws al-Anṣārī.

teachers.label: Isḥāq al-Musayyabī
teachers.translation: Khalaf read under Sulaym, the companion of Ḥamza, as has preceded; under Yaʿqūb b. Khalīfa al-Aʿshā, the companion of Abū Bakr; and under Abū Zayd Saʿīd b. Aws al-Anṣārī, the companion of al-Mufaḍḍal al-Ḍabbī and Abān al-ʿAṭṭār. Abū Bakr, al-Mufaḍḍal, and Abān read under ʿĀṣim, and the chain of ʿĀṣim has preceded. He transmitted the *ḥurūf* from Isḥāq al-Musayyabī.
teachers.note: the verb is *rawā al-ḥurūf* ("transmitted the *ḥurūf*"), so the book does not say that Khalaf read the Qurʾān under him.

teachers.label: al-Kisāʾī
teachers.translation: Khalaf read under Sulaym, the companion of Ḥamza, as has preceded; under Yaʿqūb b. Khalīfa al-Aʿshā, the companion of Abū Bakr; and under Abū Zayd Saʿīd b. Aws al-Anṣārī, the companion of al-Mufaḍḍal al-Ḍabbī and Abān al-ʿAṭṭār. Abū Bakr, al-Mufaḍḍal, and Abān read under ʿĀṣim, and the chain of ʿĀṣim has preceded. He transmitted the *ḥurūf* from Isḥāq al-Musayyabī, the companion of Nāfiʿ, and from Yaḥyā b. Ādam, from Abū Bakr as well, and from al-Kisāʾī.
teachers.note: the index adds that the book says he transmitted the *ḥurūf* from al-Kisāʾī and did not read under him by full recitation (*wa-lam yaqraʾ ʿalayhi ʿarḍan*).

teachers.label: Salīm b. ʿĪsā al-Ḥanafī
teachers.translation: Khalaf read under Sulaym.
teachers.note: the full sentence in the book continues with *ṣāḥib Ḥamza kamā taqaddama* ("the companion of Ḥamza, as has preceded"), which refers to Sulaym's reading under Ḥamza.

teachers.label: Yaḥyā b. Ādam
teachers.translation: Khalaf read under Sulaym, the companion of Ḥamza, as has preceded; under Yaʿqūb b. Khalīfa al-Aʿshā, the companion of Abū Bakr; and under Abū Zayd Saʿīd b. Aws al-Anṣārī, the companion of al-Mufaḍḍal al-Ḍabbī and Abān al-ʿAṭṭār. Abū Bakr, al-Mufaḍḍal, and Abān read under ʿĀṣim, and the chain of ʿĀṣim has preceded. He transmitted the *ḥurūf* from Isḥāq al-Musayyabī, the companion of Nāfiʿ, and from Yaḥyā b. Ādam.
teachers.note: the verb is *rawā al-ḥurūf*, not *qaraʾa ʿalā*. The page continues with *ʿan Abī Bakrin aydan* ("from Abū Bakr as well"), which indicates that Yaḥyā is transmitting from Shuʿba.

teachers.label: Yaʿqūb b. Khalīfa al-Aʿshā
teachers.translation: Khalaf read under Sulaym, the companion of Ḥamza, as has preceded, and under Yaʿqūb b. Khalīfa al-Aʿshā.

students.label: Idrīs
students.translation: Al-Ḥaddād and al-Warrāq read under the imam Abū Muḥammad Khalaf b. Hishām b. Thaʿlab al-Bazzār.

students.label: Isḥāq
students.translation: Al-Ḥaddād and al-Warrāq read under the imam Abū Muḥammad Khalaf b. Hishām b. Thaʿlab al-Bazzār.
students.note: the book gives only the epithet al-Warrāq here. The index identifies him as Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm al-Warrāq from the context, as the transmitter of Khalaf's own selection whose routes are listed just before; his son Muḥammad is a separate al-Warrāq. The sentence serves both entries, and Idrīs corresponds to the other named reader, al-Ḥaddād.
